== Biography ==
Barbara was born before 1715.
== Research Notes ==
=== Dundonald family assessment ===

[[Stevenson-14560|Barbara Stevenson]] is the confidently identified mother of [[Glasgow-4101|William Glasgow]], assessed at 99% subjective confidence. His retained Findmypast transcript records a Dundonald baptism on 12 June 1733 and explicitly names Barbara Stevenson as mother (OPR 590/1, item 3, p.82; SCOT/OPR/BAP/3536725). FamilySearch XYZB-Z9Z concerns this same 1733 child. The two indexes represent one underlying register, not independent historical corroboration.

Select [[Glasgow-3586|William Glasgow]], the weaver at Achenyeards named as Jean’s father in the 1 October 1732 Dundonald baptism, as [[Glasgow-4101|William Glasgow]]’s possible father at 52% subjective confidence. The children share the uncommon surname and parish, their entries occur on nearby pages of the same register, and the boy’s William name agrees with the proposed father. The proposed father’s association with Barbara Stevenson is tree-derived; no inspected marriage or entry naming both parents corroborates that pairing. The whole father proposition remains an indirect household reconstruction.

The 1733 transcript has no father field or residence; absence from a transcript does not establish what the manuscript contains or prove illegitimacy. The 1732 transcript names William, weaver at Achenyeards, but no mother. Their baptisms are only 254 days apart, about eight and a half months: close spacing weakens a routine successive-infant-birth interpretation, while unknown birth dates and possible delayed baptism leave the proposed siblings compatible. Do not manufacture birth dates to resolve it. Another Glasgow father, a different Barbara Stevenson, and two separate local families remain alternatives. Barbara’s identification with her own 1733 citation is strong; the adult couple and cross-child father assignment are separate inferences. Jean’s transcript names no mother, and shared maternity of the two children remains unproved. The earlier Ayrshire William accounts [[Glasgow-1055]], [[Glasgow-3288]] and [[Glasgow-1061]] remain compatible wider comparisons; estimated ages or missing family details do not exclude them. No record links this father to any of their birth families, so no upstream father is selected. Identification of this child with later newspaper, maritime or American Williams remains unproved.
